title: MAIS Promotion Gate shadow receipt v1
description: Fail-closed machine receipt for a started Promotion Gate shadow attempt. Pass, controlled fail, and blocked attempts are receipted; invalid pre-attempt input uses the CLI error envelope.

historyTrustBoundary.const: Execution HEAD first-parent history only; remote and divergent ref uniqueness requires required PR/main post-merge enforcement.
